title: Pan-Seared Dutch Bread with Toast Crunch
description: A crispy and crunchy vegetarian snack, ideal for a quick break, made with hearty Dutch bread and toasted for added texture.
instructions: Slice the Dutch bread into 1-inch thick slices.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Place the bread slices on a baking sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes.
Garnish with fresh thyme if desired.
Cut the toasted bread into cubes.
Mix the bread cubes with toasted bread crumbs.
